newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean investment abroad rises Jan-Sept.
newsitem.headline: Chilean investment abroad rises Jan-Sept.

text.p: Investment by Chilean companies abroad rose to just over $3 billion in the first nine months of the year, up six percent over the same period in 1995, said a report from the Santiago Chamber of Commerce.
Most of the investment was concentrated in countries in the Mercosur trade bloc with the bulk spent on projects in Argentina and Peru, said the chamber.
Industrial projects accounted for 40 percent of the investment, followed by the energy sector with nearly 30 percent and and trade on 27 percent.
"Continuing with the trend started in the first half of the year, we have observed a sharp fall in the importance of privatizations in the process," said the report.
Privatizations, which have in the past spear-headed Chilean investment abroad, accounted for just four percent of investment in the third quarter of the year, it said.
